issue.body:
### Description

When the message in the `commit-summary` element is too long then the table scales beyond the page width. See screenshot. This is independent of the theme chosen (tested with Forgejo and Codeberg theme).

Easily reproduced by doing "Inspect" in the browser and typing extra text in https://try.gitea.io
Firefox version 108.0.1 (64-bit) on Ubuntu 22.04.1 LTS (5.15.0-57-generic)

_(First reported downstream in [Forgejo/#235](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues/235))_

### Gitea Version

1.18.0+50-g5a46a564 (codeberg)

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

Yes

### Log Gist

_No response_

### Screenshots

![Screenshot of layout issue](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5111931/212051018-b1ac6a14-1487-48ed-a425-b6f5fc0c3dd7.png)


### Git Version

_No response_

### Operating System

_No response_

### How are you running Gitea?

This occurs in the current Codeberg installation.

### Database

None

issue.body:
There was an unintended regression in #21124 which assumed that `.commits-list .message-wrapper` would only match the commit summaries on `/{owner}/{name}/commits/*`. This assumption is incorrect as the directory/file view also uses a `.commits-list` wrapper.

Rather than completely restructure this page this PR simply adjusts the styling to again use `display: inline-block;` for `#repo-files-table .commit-list .message-wrapper`

Fix #22360

Signed-off-by: Andrew Thornton <art27@cantab.net>
